description: Turns a plan into a shot list a crew can work from. Input: plan; format, "json" (default, dpl.shot-list/1) or "markdown"; vocabulary, an optional industry vocabulary for camera terms (for example "movielabs@1.0"). Output: the shot list, or {format:"markdown", markdown}. No AI model runs. We don't keep the plan. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account, and is free up to 3 projects a month. A project is identified by the plan's work id and title; it counts when this tool first makes a finished document for it that month. shoot_plan_allowance says what is left. Over the limit it answers ALLOWANCE_REACHED: do not retry, a new key will not help, tell your human. A fair-use limit also applies: up to 20 finished-document calls for any one project and 60 for the account each month. To count projects we keep, against your account, a one-way fingerprint (hash) of the project's id and title, the month, how many finished documents were made and when, for 13 months after the end of that month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

vocabulary.description: Optional industry vocabulary for camera terms, for example movielabs@1.0.

name: shoot_plan_shot_list
title: Make a shot list from a plan
